main.description: A self-declared opt-out from skymash's comparison pool, written by the account itself — not by whoever nominated it. Anyone can nominate any eligible account, but only the account's own repo can hold a valid opt-out for itself, so this is the one record kind that respects self-removal without requiring cooperation from (or deletion rights over) the nominator's record. A single fixed record key ("self") per repo; skymash's pool logic excludes any subject with a live opt-out record on its own repo, regardless of how many times it's been nominated or by whom. Written and read by skymash (https://skymash.bisks.net).

subject.description: Must equal the DID of the repo this record lives in — an opt-out only ever applies to its own author.

optedOutAt.description: When this opt-out was written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
